customers_say: Customers find the smart door lock to be a premium product with solid build quality and good security features. The installation process is smoothly done, and they appreciate its many features, with one customer highlighting the fingerprint and passcode entry options. The functionality receives mixed reviews - while many say it works well, some report issues with the front lock not working and the fingerprint scanner stopping unexpectedly. Additionally, connectivity is a concern, with several customers reporting no WiFi connectivity.
